snippet.title: Bloodshed in the Big Blue House (Pico VS. Bear Original)
snippet.description:
This is the Original version of Pico VS. Bear that I found!! 
Go to 1:08 to skip the beginning n' crap. 
After the game was first published, The Jim Henson Company sent Tom Fulp an Email requesting the game to be removed due to copyright infringement. As a result of this, the game was quickly updated to make a number of aspects less infringing.
The game used to be called "Bloodshed in the Big House that Blew" but was changed in the 2006 Update to "Pico VS. Bear"
#PicoVSBear
#Pico
#Newgrounds
I OWN NOTHING!!!!!!!!!!!!!
